Mari's Banana Cupcakes
By: Mari
Published: Friday, January 8, 2010 - 8:26am

Ingredients




Ingredients:

4 banana (5 oz) mashed
1 cup sugar
2 eggs, lightly beaten
3/4 cup vegetable oil
2 cups flour
2 teaspoons baking soda
3 tablespoons buttermilk
1 cup pecans (optional)
1 cup sugar to decorate

Preparation

1 Preparation: 2 Pre-heat oven to 300 F 3 Slightly beat the bananas with sugar, 4 Add the eggs one by one,Add oil and beat until well blended, about 1-2 minutes mind.Add flour with baking powder and 3 tablespoons buttermilk. Mix well.Pour into the tray of cupcakes, and bake previously preheated to 300 F. Bake for 20-30 minutes or until toothpick inserted is clean.

About


These cupcakes are fluffy, moist and gooooood, you can eat at any time of day. This recipe is very easy to do.

Comments:
Melissa Peterman

Heavenly!!!
